name: Both-Sides Dismantlability Definition
statement: An ample class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$ belongs to $\mathsf B$ exactly when both $C$ and $\{0,1\}^X\setminus C$ are dismantlable ample; the empty complementary shore is allowed.
hypotheses: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
